title: Dry run: shiftRight on [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

steps.note: Save the last element: end = arr[7] = 8.
The loop starts at i = 7. 7 > 0 is true.
arr[7] = arr[6] = 7. The old 8 is overwritten, but it's safe in end.
arr[1] = arr[0] = 1. Indices 1..7 now hold the shifted values.
i = 0. 0 > 0 is false, so the loop ends after 7 moves (size - 1).
arr[0] = end = 8. The saved last element wraps around to the front.
Return [8, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], which matches the expected output for Test 8.
